value.text: At the saved source revision c289b28be4819eddf29d59a7c12f178559ec5229, the Forecasts service declares three HTTP handlers and a Kafka listener for weather.place-requested. The forecast endpoint reads a stored payload by place id; health executes a database ping; OpenAPI reads the checked-in forecasts contract. The listener validates place.requested v1 events, records and acknowledges invalid messages before returning, and sends valid events through a transaction callback that inserts the inbox id, upserts the place and calls refresh before reaching the later acknowledgment; runtime callback and transaction behavior remain unverified. Refresh returns early while cached data is unexpired; otherwise fixture or live-provider processing can update the forecast record and attempt a forecast.updated outbox insert. The source includes two scheduled entrypoint declarations, refreshExpired and publishPending; runtime activation is unverified. Kotlin parsing is source-syntax only; the saved capture did not build the service, and runtime activation is unverified.
